text: Moves-Unseen is an Argonian member of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at Fort Virak.
Morvan Treveur is a traveling Breton merchant. He is found on the road east of Valeguard Tower in Rivenspire.
Morkuldin Guardian is a generic Guardian residing in Morkul Stronghold in .
Mordrold is a Nord residing in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City. He is attempting to re-purpose a former combat factotim, Retail Assistant, into a shopkeeper.
Mother Gilrielas is a wispmother that can be found in Grahtwood.
Mother of Rats is an apraxic Altmer found in the waterworks in the city of Shimmerene in the Summerset Isles.
Mornurdur is a banker in . He works at the Alinor Bank and Trust in Alinor on the isle of Summerset.
Mother Ciannait is a monster set in . It is based on Mother Ciannait from Icereach.

Morothmash gro-Uzug is a character located in North Beacon, Auridon, in . He is a former Daggerfall Covenant officer who defected and sided with the Aldmeri Dominion alongside his wife, Lakhazga gro-Rimat.
Mynisera was the Dowager Queen of Daggerfall. Mynisera is the widow of King Lysandus of Daggerfall and is the mother of the current King, Gothryd. She was a trusted friend of Uriel Septim VII.
Murudius Flaeus is an Imperial Pauper living in Hla Oad. It seems that Murudius has had some bad luck while gambling, and owes a Hlaalu noble a fair sum of gold.
Mush-Mere is an Argonian Pauper who lives in Gnaar Mok, Morrowind.
Mundrila Ienith is a Dunmer pilgrim in Molag Mar, Morrowind. She resides at The Pilgrim's Rest in the city's waistworks. Mundrila does not offer any services and is not involved in any quests.
Muvis Moran is a Dunmer Bard located at Desele's House of Earthly Delights in Suran.

Murberius Harmevus is an Imperial warrior living in Pelagiad, Vvardenfell. He can be found at his house across the road from the Halfway Tavern. He is not involved in any quests, and there is little reason for the Nerevarine to engage him in conversation.
Mug gro-Dulob is an Orsimer living in Fort Darius Imperial Legion base in the city of Gnisis.
Musa Yahaz is a Dunmer farmer living in Gnisis in the West Gash.

Mucianus Allias was a member of the Mages Guild that worked undercover within cults of Necromancers. While some members of the guild didn't trust him being undercover with the necromancers, he was a loyal member of the guild.

Muurine is an Altmer mage who lives in her house in Crucible. She is obsessed with finding out the latest gossip and conspiracy theories. She lives in her house in the center of Crucible with Uncle Leo, a non-hostile zombie.
Muiri is a Breton apothecary's assistant for Bothela at The Hag's Cure in Markarth.
Murbul is an Orsimer destruction mage residing in the stronghold of Dushnikh Yal, where she serves as the community's wise woman.
Mug gro-Murgak is a worshipper of the Daedric Prince Malacath. He can be found at Malacath's Shrine.

Mythic Dawn Leader is a follower of the Mythic Dawn. They can be encountered in Lake Arrius Caverns during the quest "Dagon Shrine." In combat they will usually summon the Bound Mythic Dawn Armor and a Bound Weapon.
Muriel Sette is a Breton thief in who owns Dirty Muriel's Cornerclub in Sadrith Mora. Like most of her patrons she is a member of the Thieves Guild.
Mulvisie Othril is a Dunmer assassin and slaver who resides in the cave Addamasartus. She is the leader of the slaver group here.
Muzgonk gro-Borbog is a hostile Orsimer warrior and Malacath worshiper residing in the Daedric shrine of Ashurnibibi.
Muz-Ra is an Argonian Slave who is being held in the slaver cave of Zainsipilu. The Nerevarine can free her along with the other slaves in the cave.

The Mudcrab Merchant is a friendly mudcrab who can be found on a small island, just to the east of Mzahnch Ruin in the Azura's Coast region. He is an easter egg, and is notable for being the richest merchant in .

Murkub gro-Ushul is an Orsimer Barbarian found in the Underworks of the Vivec, Foreign Quarter. He is located just outside of the shrine Ibishammus guarding it. Murkub is hostile to the Nerevarine on sight.
Murzush gra-Bulfim is an Orsimer Warrior found in the Outer Shrine of the Daedric Shrine Bal Fell. She is one of the people located on the outer shrine to Sheogorath, in Bal Fell.
Mugdul gro-Yagarz is an Orsimer Barbarian residing in the Dwemer Ruin of Mzuleft.
Murkwater War Guards are goblins encountered in Fungal Grotto in .
Murag gro-Atumph is an Orsimer Barbarian, and slaver residing in the cave of Kudanat. He will be hostile towards the Nerevarine upon sight.
Mubdan Esurnadarpal is a Dunmer Scout that can be found wandering the Ashlands of Vvardenfell.
Mut Urshan-Adairan is a Dunmer Barbarian who can be found wandering the territory of the Ashlands of Morrowind.
Musan Zaintashara is a Dunmer Scout who resides in the Grazelands of Morrowind.
Munbebi Addarari is an Dunmer Mabrigash who resides in the Azura's Coast region located within Morrowind.
Muazzaz is a Breton residing in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. She is sitting on the terrace outside Headman Bhosek's Palace.
Murdyn Veralas is a Dunmer residing in Davon's Watch in Stonefalls. He is found sitting on a bench across The Watch House and he offers no unique dialogue.
Murdan is a Khajiit residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Muhada is a Khajiit found at the stalls of the Redfur Trading Post. She has no unique dialogue.
Multa is an Orsimer residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.
Muram is a Khajiit member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch at the Redfur Trading Post.
Mylenne is a Breton residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. She is found outside, walking about.

Mugumurn gra-Lumborn is an Orsimer residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven. She is typically can be found in the Town Square of the village, where she watches Constable Pascal being put in the stocks after the quest "False Accusations."
Mubdan Assantinalit is a Dunmer Barbarian residing in the region of West Gash.
Mus Roscius is an Imperial knight residing in the Gandrung Caverns with a group of smugglers.
Muzur is Khajiit merchant found in the Temple of the Crescent Moon in the region of Khenarthi's Roost. He is collecting apples that fell out of his basket.
Munarir is a Khajiit weaponsmith. He sells his wares at his stall, Fang & Claw, at the Moonfire Forge in Mistral.
Mulama is a Khajiit woodworker of the Baandari Clan. She sells her wares at her stall, Taut-String Traders, at their caravan settled in Kozanset.
Muranatepa is an Argonian woodworker in who resides with Iron-In-Blood at the stall "Blood is not Rust" in the Dhalmora Hall of Merchants, Bal Foyen.
Muruuna is a Redguard woodworker residing in the city of Sentinel. He owns a woodworking stall called The Sanded Scorpion at the Sentinel Bazaar.
Mulimah is a Redguard appearing in . She resides in the outlaws refuge beneath city of Sentinel.
Munbi Svel is a Dunmer armorer and a member of the Fighters Guild residing in the city of Ebonheart. He is found at the local branch, selling his wares.
Mubayda is a Khajiit residing in the port city of Mistral, in Khenarthi's Roost just outside Cat's Eye Quay.
Murundius Atticus is a character residing in the city of Camlorn.
Mullas Aram is a Dunmer seen carrying crates at the docks of Shad Astula.
Muriil Othreloth is a Dunmer found inside the dormitory of Shad Astula.
Murarel is an Altmer member of the Mages Guild residing on the island of Eyevea.
Muheh is a Redguard guild trader found at the Moonlight Market in the city of Rawl'kha.
Mylo Bertault is a Breton patron of the Caravan Company Depot in Dragonstar.
Murgrud is a character residing in the Baandari Trading Post.
Muhay at-Naruk is a Redguard member of the Star-Gazers residing at the Star-Gazers' Observatory and Belkarth.
Muduk is an Orsimer found in the Hall of Judgment in the city of Bergama in the Alik'r Desert.
Murk-Watcher is an Argonian residing in Dro-Dara Plantation, Stormhaven.
Muzdrulz is a Orsimer residing in the Davon's Watch Outlaws Refuge.
Mysteries-of-Trees is an Argonian residing in The Gray Mire, Grahtwood.
Mubdi is a Redguard commoner found at the Sisters of the Sands Inn in the city of Sentinel, Alik'r Desert.
Mujee-Naat is an Argonian who resides in the town of Hissmir, Shadowfen.
Mulatub gro-Gush is a character residing in the town of Wind Keep.
Murdyn Athren is a Dunmer magus and a member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Windhelm.
Muz-Muz is an Argonian boatswain who travels between the cities of Windhelm and Alten Corimont.
Mudush is a Orsimer residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh. She is often found loitering by the Stonetooth Smithy.
Mureesh is a Redguard who resides in Port Hunding, in the region of Stros M'Kai. He has no unique dialogue.
Munabi is a Dunmer Ashlander of the Mabrigash Tribe. She is found at their village located in the Vale of the Ghost Snake.
Murinman is a Khajiit slave found in the pens of Kragenmoor.
Myl Falas is a Dunmer patron of the Trader's Rest in Velyn Harbor.
Murotha is an Orsimer armsman of the Fighters Guild residing in the city of Orsinium.
Murdodosh is an Orsimer commoner found in the city of Orsinium. He can be seen talking to Arzakh, but the Vestige can not interact with him.
Mulgargh is an Orsimer farmer found taking care of the animals outside of Skalar's Hostel, in the outskirts of the city of Orsinium.
Mulzah is an Orsimer found in The Greedy Gut in the city of Orsinium. She is the daughter of the innkeeper, Mazabakh.
Musi is a dog that appears in the Alik'r Desert location of Artisan's Oasis. She was enchanted to be resurrected after the death. Her owner is Tarshea.
Muzuli is a Khajiit member of the Fighters Guild. She is the hall steward of their branch in Arenthia.
Mulabez is a traveling Khajiit merchant found on the road between Longhaven and Woodhearth.
Murzgut is an Orsimer found wandering the streets of Morkul Stronghold in Wrothgar. She is impossible to interact with.
Mulzara is an Orsimer alchemist residing at the Morkul Stronghold in Wrothgar. She can be found in the Clan Longhouse, selling her wares.
Murak-Lei is an Argonian traveling merchant walking the road from the milegate of Bal Foyen to Davon's Watch.
Muhmeylah is a Redguard residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Murzog is an Orsimer found sweeping the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast.
Murmurs-to-Trees is an Argonian member of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at Boulderfall Pass.
Muz-Medul is an Argonian member of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at Fort Virak.
Munyat is a Khajiit found sleeping at his stall, Munyat's Many Things, in the Outskirts of Rawl'kha.
Mudyn is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is part of the contingent encountered in Ten-Maur-Wolk. He is found dying in the ruins.
Musius is an Imperial spirit found inside the Cave of Broken Sails.
Munalur is a Khajiit patron of the Outside Inn in the city of Elden Root, Grahtwood.
Muslabeh is a Khajiit found with his companion Ei-Ei at their camp in Auridon.
Murgonak is an Orsimer carpenter running Woodworking Wonders in the Foundation's Bulwark marketplace in Vivec City. He can provide carpentry services to the Vestige.
Muzgalg is an Orsimer member of the Malacath Fanatics who have taken control of the Temple of Ire, in the city of Orsinium.
Mush-Jekka is an Argonian residing in Mother's Den, a sublocation of the Shimmerene Waterworks underneath the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He has no unique dialogue.

Mulvarion is an Altmer who can be found at the edge of the poaceae fields southwest from Ceporah Tower in Artaeum. He cannot be interacted with, and simply watches a nearby Atronach Worker tend to the fields in front of him.
Mula is an Orsimer who can be found in the Hall of Illumination in the Illumination Academy in Summerset. She cannot be interacted with.
Muazel is a Redguard who guards the gates of Hubalajad Palace and asks for invitations from the guests.
Murukh is an Orsimer hunter located near Bonerock Cavern. He is first found during the events of "Riekr Revenge," where he is found injured, but afterwards can be found in Orgotha's camp.
Muzgraga gra-Khambol is an Orsimer member of the Evermore City Guard. She is part of the squad sent to investigate the troubles of Murcien's Hamlet.
Mulnus Veterna is an Imperial drunkard residing in Rimmen. He can be found gambling with Narluz and Plexica Scavius. He has no unique dialogue.
Muzzi is a Khajiit found at Sandswirl Manor. He is found cowering in the stables.
Mukka is an Argonian member of the Root-House Tribe found at the Glade of Chimes in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.
Mud Hoppers are passive creatures that appears in Summerset, Artaeum, and Murkmire. They can be found near bodies of water.
Mulzalt is an Orsimer bard residing in the Gateway Inn in Sadrith Mora.
Muz-Gei is an Argonian residing in the Solitude Fighters Guild in Solitude.

Muzariah was a famous Dunmer painter. Though Indoril by birth, she was a painter by a choice, a rather uncommon scenario. Her death was at the hands of "the Three Angry Men". Her best painting lies in the cellars of the Imperial Palace; Jobasha referred to it as a dilemma that no one was allowed to see it, but it was too beautiful to be destroyed. Her skill is comparable to that of Cherim.
Muz-Shah is an Argonian in . He is located in Faldar's Tooth in the Rift, Pariah Abbey in Stormhaven, and Cold-Blood Cavern in Shadowfen.
Muguur gra-Bor is an Orc ghost located in Crestshade, Rivenspire, in .
Murderil is an Altmer residing in Corgrad Wastes, Summerset. He is a son of Kinlord Nemfarion and a member of the ruling house of Corgrad. He has a brother Rultarion.

Narina Carvain is an Imperial and the Countess of Bruma at the end of the Third Era. She is known for being a crisp countess, ruthless in negotiations and cunning in thought. During the Oblivion Crisis, she played a crucial role in the events that led to the Second Battle of Bruma, allowing Martin Septim to proceed with his plan to allow the Daedra to attack the city. She was also known to be an avid collector of Akaviri artifacts.
Nathyn Ilnith is a Dunmer living in the Redoran Stronghold of Marandus. He is also a member of House Redoran.
Nadene Rotheran is a Dunmer Commoner who lives in Gnaar Mok, Morrowind. Her home is used as a meeting place for the Camonna Tong in town. She, however, is not a member.

Nande is an Altmer Hunter who resides in Molag Mar, Morrowind. He can be found loitering near St. Veloth's Hostel at the plaza atop the city. Nande is equipped in chitin armor and wields a chitin short bow. He does not offer any services and is not involved in any quests.
Mzunchend was a famous Dwemer who invented the first pin lock. It is said that his locks were so valuable that only royalty could afford them.
Nammu Man-llu is a Dunmer farmer residing in Gnisis in the West Gash.
Nash gro-Khazor is an Orsimer guard residing in the town of Gnisis in the West Gash. He is a member of the Imperial Legion.
Nahsi is a Khajiit member of the Fighters Guild in Bravil. She offers Hand-to-Hand training up to Apprentice level.

This is the home of Nanette Don, the apprentice of Relmyna Verenim. It's a small two story building with just one room and the bed upstairs. She doesn't care about the Gates of Madness being open because she is blessed by Sheogorath and so may be here or in Xaselm with her master.
Natch Pinder is an Imperial pauper residing in his home in the inhospitable settlement of Hackdirt.
Namanian Facian is a Nightblade and an Imperial member of the Morag Tong residing in the Sadrith Mora guild hall. He has a number of spells for sale.
Naspis Apinia is an Imperial trader, and resides in the Moonmoth Legion Fort. He is a member of the Imperial Cult. He is also a merchant, and has a variety of goods for sale.
Natalinus Flavonius is an Imperial who resides in Wolverine Hall, which is located on the island of Sadrith Mora.
Nahkriin (Dragon Language: Nahkriin, "") is one of the eight named dragon priests.
Nataly Dravarol, also spelled Natalia, is a cartographer who worked during the Third and Fourth Era. She is best known as the creator of the map of Cyrodiil in 3E 433 and the map of Skyrim in 4E 182.
Nagrub is an Orsimer ranger residing in the stronghold of Dushnikh Yal.
Nads Tharen is a deceased Dunmer thief who Gentleman Jim Stacey wants to find as he is worried about him. Instead, the Nerevarine finds his corpse.
Nachael is a Redguard Agent in the Morag Tong Guild in Balmora.
Nalasa Sarothren is a Dunmer Scout residing at the Elven Nations Cornerclub in the Hlaalu Canton of Vivec. She is a member of House Hlaalu.

Nathyne Uvelas is a Dunmer guard in Venim Manor in Ald'ruhn. She is one of the guards tasked with preventing the escape or rescue of Varvur Sarethi from a secret room in the manor. She does not provide unique information.
Naalia is a character mentioned in . She is the deceased mother of Aventus Aretino and lived at the Aretino Residence.
Nalsie Radas is a Dunmer Rogue and a member of a bandit gang that has occupied the Dunmer stronghold Andasreth. She can be found on the lower level and is hostile.
Nag gro-Shumba is an Orsimer Barbarian and slaver residing in the stronghold of Hlormaren. He can be found on the bottom level of the stronghold's keep.
Nalis Gals is a Dunmer Trader who resides in the Vivec City, St. Olms Canton.
Naris Mavani is a Dunmer miner residing in the town of Raven Rock. He works at the Raven Rock Mine there, where he is typically found.
Naral Othreleth is a Dunmer Miner who can be found working in Dunirai Caverns.

Nalosi Alari is a Dunmer member of the Ordinators. He can be found on guard duty outside the northern door to the Hall of Wisdom in Vivec City, located in the northeast corner of Temple Canton directly across the bridge from St. Olms Canton. Unlike most of Nalosi's peers, he is not a member of the Tribunal Temple.
Nartise Arobar is a Dunmer Commoner who was kidnapped by Neloth and is currently being held hostage in Tel Naga.
Nanine is a Redguard warrior found in The Covenant in Tel Mora.
Naris Selaren is a Dunmer agent residing in Sha-Adnius, east of Khuul.
Narisa Adus is a Dunmer journalist who resides in the sewers beneath Mournhold's Great Bazaar district.
Nalvilie Saren is a Dunmer clothier who resides in the Vivec, St. Olms Canton.
Nannithon is a Redguard warrior and member of House Telvanni, who resides in the Vivec, Telvanni Canton. He can be found bunking in the Temporary Telvanni Housing.

Nasmat is a Redguard first met in the Screaming Mermaid in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. She has been involved with Jakarn and along with Irien and Elethien, they want him to make up his mind when all meet on the ship back to Daggerfall. After the quest "Innocent Scoundrel" has been completed, she standing among several Jakarn's admirers. She later appears in the Cloudy Dregs Inn, in Wayrest where she tells the Vestige, that this establishment is a class above the Screaming Mermaid.
Nar gro-Shagramph is an Orsimer barbarian who resides the in the Hlaalu Canton Plaza in Vivec City.

Narrald Snow-Bourne is Nord farmer residing in Bleakrock Village on the island of Bleakrock Isle. When he first came to the island, he served under Tillrani Snow-Bourne. After some time, he married her and settled in Bleakrock, building with her Snow-Bourne House. He was killed during Covenant assault on village.
Nalami Veleth is an Dunmer commoner who resides in the Vivec, Hlaalu Canton.
Narvyn Darano is a Dunmer mystic. He sells his wares at his stall, Narvyn's Arcane Emporium, in the market district of Davon's Watch.
Nalmila Thelas is a Dunmer Crusader and member of Tribunal Temple, who resides in the Ordinator Barracks in the Vivec, Temple Canton.
Nakuma is an Argonian Slave who resides in the Arena of Rotheran.
Nam-La is an Argonian Slave who resides in the Arena of Rotheran.

Naryu Virian is a Dunmer who seeks contact with the Vestige in Deshaan. She is an assassin of the Morag Tong who was hired to eliminate the source of the Llodos Plague and will therefore seek the help of the Vestige. Alongside senior member Varon Davel, the two are the only remaining members of their cell within the Tong. With the Morag Tong persecuted during the Second Era first from the assassination of the Reman Potentate and from the Dark Brotherhood schism, the members of the guild have gone into hiding and are working from the shadows to try and build connections with powerful nobles and regain the strength and influence they once had.
Nagaddu is a Khajiit merchant. He sells his wares at his stall, Practical Treasures, in Elden Root.
Nardis is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild. He is the hall steward of their branch in Mournhold, Deshaan.
Nadwa is a Redguard warrior residing in Port Hunding, on the island of Stros M'Kai. She spends her days listens to a musician by the large fountain.
Nabal-dar is a Khajiit residing in the town of Woodhearth, Greenshade. He is usually found outside Five Claws Inn.
Nagarra is a Khajiit residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.
Nals Indrano is a Dunmer witchhunter and member of the Tribunal Temple residing in the Daedric Shrine of Ald Daedroth within the Inner Shrine.
Narile Sadoro is a Dunmer commoner residing within The Rat in the Pot in Ald'ruhn.
Nathala Herendas is a Dunmer Witchhunter residing in the Daedric Ruins of Ald Sotha.
Narivys Sadreno is a Dunmer magus and a member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Alcaire Castle.
Naslan is a Redguard residing in the Alik'r Camp, outside the walls of Alcaire Castle. She is found just outside the camp.

Naril Heleran is a Dunmer thief first found at the Rededication Shrine in Davon's Watch. He seeks aid in acquiring an exquisite bottle of wine. He is encountered later again in Ebonheart, where he is on another wine-related venture.
Naarcaano is an Altmer member of the Mages Guild found in Ezduiin, an ancient Ayleid ruin in Auridon.
Naddu Indoril is a Dunmer of House Indoril residing in Mournhold.
Naloso Andoril is a Dunmer priest found inside the Tribunal Temple of Mournhold.
Nabeenim is a Redguard merchant residing in the town of Bergama, Alik'r Desert. She can be found at Morwha's Basket selling her wares.
Nalyarie is an Altmer tailor residing in her shop in the city of Marbruk.
Nanimir is a Redguard banker residing in the Northern High Rock Gate.
Narkhozikh is an Orsimer fence found at the Sentinel Outlaws Refuge in the Alik'r Desert.
Nadras Hlor is a Dunmer of House Dres residing inside the Grandmaster's Palace in Kragenmoor.
Nanthenas is a Bosmer magus member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Silvenar.
Naryni Redothan is a Dunmer found inside the dormitory of Shad Astula.
Nanza at-Fada is a Redguard alchemist and member of the Mages Guild working at Vaifa's House of Enchantment and Admixtures on the island of Eyevea.
Naburr is a Khajiit member of the Fighters Guild. He is the armsman of their branch at the Baandari Trading Post.
Nari Buteo is an Imperial member of the Seventh Legion. She is one of their agents infiltrated in Evermore.
Nariam is a Dremora serving as the boss of the ruins of Norvulk.
Nandim is a Redguard drunkard residing in the city of Windhelm. He has no unique dialogue.
Nathrasa Shimmerscale is a powerful Argonian rogue member of the Scaled Court found inside Skyreach Hold.
Naifineh is a Redguard guild trader found at Trunkshade Traders in the city of Elden Root, Grahtwood.
Narkularz is an Orsimer clothier residing in the town of Shor's Stone.

Narir is a Nord working at Shor's Stone's mine, the Rift, in . Following the reachmen attack on the village, he decides to join The Companions. He is encountered again at Taarengrav and Trolhetta afterwards.
Narvilda is a Nord commoner residing in the town of Shor's Stone.
Nadahi is a Khajiit of the Baandari Clan. She is found at their trading post in Malabal Tor.
Nadya is a Redguard residing in the city of Woodhearth. She is the stablemaster at the local stable "Forest Mounts."
Nathalye Charmax is a Breton moneylender. She operates Charmex's Charming Vault out of the outlaws refuge beneath Velyn Harbor.
Nahzush is an Orsimer armorer residing in the city of Orsinium, Wrothgar. He can be found at the shop, Ash-Tongue Armorers, selling his wares.
Nargbagorn is an Orsimer warrior residing in the city of Orsinium, located in the Orsinium Fighters Guild's tavern.
Nash is an Orsimer residing in the city of Orsinium. He can be found in the Orsinium Outlaws Refuge.
Naballi is a Khajiit found at the Riverside Traders in Arenthia.
Namolelcare is an Altmer residing in the city of Firsthold. She is a member of the Mages Guild, and can be found in their guildhall.
Naldyn Indalor is a deceased Dunmer found at the mortuary in the city of Stormhold.
Nalman is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Stormhold.

Narahni is a former Khajiit slave of House Dres and the love interest of Velsa. After years of not seeing each other, Narahni contacted her via an anonymous letter. She can be found at the inn of Evermore, Rawl'kha or Riften depending on the player's alliance.
Nabar is a Redguard stablemaster and proprietor of Hoof In Hand Stables in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Nalthenlir is a Bosmer residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Nathyne Selvilo is a Dunmer residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Narzasir is a Redguard mage residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.

Nathon Ice-Storm is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact. Him and his brother Israk were caught and held hostages by The Darklings, a group of hostile Azura worshippers established at Faldar's Tooth. After being liberated, the brothers relocate to Riften.
Narkir is a character residing in the Hubalajad Palace in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Nabdanir is a Redguard found in the Hubalajad Palace in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane. He can be seen talking to Falleh and Nebuin, but is impossible to interact with.

in Al-Danobia's Tomb.]] Narimaya was a Yokudan leader from times of the civil war of Yokuda. She was the sister of Tunaska, who was a rival Yokudan leader. She also had two trusted advisors - Nishka the Symbol of Pride and Puntru the Scholar. Carved depictions of Narimaya are found in Al-Danobia's Tomb in Hew's Bane.
Narhag gro-Shatul is an Orsimer stablemaster offering his services in Midnight Riders just outside the northern gates of Anvil, Gold Coast.
Natareth is a Bosmer beggar found in Anvil, The Gold Coast. She can be seen at the docks, near the Prowler. She cannot be interacted with.
Narion is a Bosmer found near the Falinesti Spring Site in Greenshade. She is a member of the Hounds of Hircine and is tracking a powerful mammoth.
Nara is a Bosmer member of the Vinedusk Rangers found in Dread Vullain in Greenshade. She has been sent to investigate recent sightings of the Shade of Naemon in the area.
Narfar War-Wolf is a Nord traveling merchant. He sells his wares on the road south of Jorunn's Stand.
Nanwen is an Altmer spirit found within the Ayleid ruins of Rulanyil's Fall.
Naranbar is an Altmer found within the outlaws refuge located beneath Vulkhel Guard. He has no unique dialogue.
Narandor is an Altmer patron of the Barbed Hook Tavern in Skywatch.
Nam-Ja is an Argonian commoner residing in Ebonheart, Stonefalls.
Nameel is an Argonian guild trader. She sells her wares at her stall, Redoubtable Deals, which is located at the Lion Guard Redoubt.
Narrows-His-Eyes is an Argonian residing in Bergama. He is under the employ of Uncle Thakh, the owner of The Winking Jackal, a local casino in the city.
Naeldil is a Bosmer residing in her house in Karthdar. She is first met during the quest "Pact Advocate," where she is a witness to the crime breaking the Green Pact.
Nalbor is a Bosmer sailor held captive by the Crimson Raiders within the Crimson Cove.
Nallion is a Bosmer residing in Cormount. She is a partisan of the newly reformed Blacksap Rebellion.
Namriel is a Bosmer member of the Aldmeri Dominion. She is found at the Eastern Elsweyr Gate.
Nadine Rielle is a Breton residing in Aldcroft. She was exiled from Camlorn with her parents, Duke Sebastien and Lady Rielle.
Nak'tah is a Reachwoman of the Dragonclaw Clan. She is competing with the rest of her clan members at the Dragonstar Arena.
Nanoyra Larcoque is a Breton noble found at the party at the At-Tura Estate.
Natalo Barbula is an Imperial beggar residing in Abah's Landing. He has no unique dialogue.
Nathalye Ervine is a Breton refugee from Crestshade. She is found in Camp Tamrith, seeking help in finding her missing husband Ignobert.
Naer is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. She is part of the team that was tasked with ridding Bleakrock Isle of its spiders problem.
Nali Radas is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their branch in Ebonheart.
Nalosi Orethi is a Dunmer found in the Trader's Cove. He is one of the assassination targets involved in the contract taking place there.

Narsis Dren is a Dunmer adventurer and author who travels across Tamriel to explore ancient ruins. He can be found exploring the Exile's Barrow in Wrothgar, Dreloth Ancestral Tomb in Vvardenfell. He can also be found in Solitude in Western Skyrim.
Naissa Ausonia is an Imperial in who resides in Cheydinhal. She can be overheard talking to Sigilis Ulpius about running off together.
Naiba is a Khajiit residing in the city of Arenthia, Reaper's March.

Namu was the mother of the Lunar Champions Khali and Shazah. She was murdered by Colovian Raiders when they attacked their residence. She appears in spirit form during the visions taking place within the temple in Rawl'kha.
Nanaglar is a Khajiit member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at the Earth Forge.
Naradani is a Khajiit of the Baandari Clan. She is found in their camp at the Martyr's Crossing.
Naragara is a Khajiit laborer working at the Altmer embassy in Elden Root.

Narwaawende is an Altmer achievement furnisher residing in either Elden Root, Mournhold, or Wayrest, depending on the Vestige's alliance. She can also be found in the Hollow City and Vivec City, in the Vivec City Furnishing store within the Saint Delyn Waistworks.
Narwende is an Altmer residing in Seyda Neen on Vvardenfell. She may also be found in Saint Delyn's Inn in the Saint Delyn Waistworks in Vivec City. She has no unique dialogue.
Nara Varam is a Dunmer member of House Telvanni found in the Saint Olms Waistworks in the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City.
Narisa Androm is a Dunmer caravaner residing in Molag Mar, Vvardenfell.
Nakhul is an Orsimer located outside of Khartag Point, in Vvardenfell.
Narsinfel Justiciar is a generic Justiciar residing in Narsinfel.
Nainab is a Dunmer Ashlander commoner residing in Urshilaku Camp on Vvardenfell. She has no unique dialogue.
Narwin is a Bosmer spirit in that is found in Dread Vullain. Since she appears in visions, she cannot be interacted with.

Nals Gimothran is a Dunmer soldier and member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City. He can be found standing guard inside the Clockwork Basilica. he has no unique dialogue

Nalvyna Dral is a Dunmer soldier and member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City. She can be found standing guard inside the Clockwork Basilica. She does not have any unique dialogue.
Nathyne Savil is a Dunmer residing in the Cloisters in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Narkhukulg is an Orsimer guild trader residing in the city of Orsinium.
Naris is a Dunmer archmage of Mages Guild. In , he gives a player the Mages Guild quests.
Namasur the Garrulous is a Redguard member of the Midnight Union residing at the At-Tura Estate in Stormhaven.
